entities.name: Đorđe Gagić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Đorđe Gagić is a Serbian professional basketball player who recently played for Lietkabelis Panevėžys of the Lithuanian Basketball League (LKL). He also represented the Serbian national basketball team in international competitions. Standing at 6 ft 11 in (2.11 m), he plays at the center position.
